meta.name: browser-cdp
meta.description: Use this skill when you need to control a Chrome browser via CDP (Chrome DevTools Protocol) to reuse existing login sessions. Covers: launching Chrome in debug mode, opening URLs, waiting for page load, evaluating JavaScript, taking snapshots, and extracting auth tokens. Trigger phrases: browser automation, CDP, agent-browser, 浏览器操作, 操作浏览器, Chrome CDP, 复用登录态, extract token from browser.

copy.tagline: 让脚本自动操作浏览器并复用现有登录状态
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你有一份已登录的浏览器会话,想通过脚本操作页面或取走登录凭证
copy.tagline_en: Control a browser with scripts and reuse an existing signed-in session
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you have a logged-in browser and want to script it or grab the auth token.

howto.what: 装上后 Claude 能通过 CDP 控制 Chrome，复用你已有的登录态：打开网页并等加载、执行 JavaScript、读取页面文本或登录 token，也能点击、输入。
howto.when: 当你提到“浏览器操作”“CDP”“复用登录态”等关键词，或要求做浏览器自动化、提取 token 时触发。首次启动会杀掉你正在用的 Chrome，需先经你同意。

say.text: 用 CDP 打开 https://example.com 并等 3 秒
say.note: 会以 debug 模式启动 Chrome 并打开该页

say.text: 把当前页面 localStorage 里的 token 取出来
用 snapshot -i 找到登录按钮再点它
say.note: 先拿元素引用，再执行点击

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude can drive Chrome over CDP and reuse your existing login sessions: open URLs, wait for load, run JavaScript, read page text or auth tokens, and click or type.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you mention "browser automation", "CDP" or "reuse login session", or ask to automate a browser or extract a token. First launch kills your running Chrome, so consent is asked first.

say_en.text: Open https://example.com via CDP and wait 3 seconds
say_en.note: Starts debug Chrome and opens the page

say_en.text: Extract the token from localStorage on the current page
say_en.note: Returns the localStorage token or cookie

say_en.text: Use snapshot -i to find the login button and click it
